headline: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale

meeting.body: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale
meeting.summary: The board fined Southshore Tiki Lounge $2,000 on each of two counts after it pleaded no contest to serving a minor decoy.
meeting.recap: The board heard a complaint against Southshore Tiki Lounge in Kīhei, which holds a restaurant liquor license.[[0:00:00]] The lounge's representative changed its plea from not guilty to no contest, meaning it would not fight the charges.[[0:02:07]] Under a deal with the department, the lounge pleaded no contest to counts one and two, and count three was dropped.[[0:02:36]] The board accepted the plea and found the lounge guilty of counts one and two.[[0:04:30]] The Department of Liquor Control said two underage decoys (minors working with inspectors) entered the lounge on June 21st, 2025.[[0:05:22]] An employee sold one decoy a mixed drink and never checked her ID.[[0:05:58]] The lounge's representative said the employee was let go.[[0:08:04]] Asked by the vice chair, he said he would put up a wall calendar to help servers check ages.[[0:13:17]] The department noted the lounge's past no contest pleas from 2017, 2022 and 2024.[[0:14:44]] The department recommended a $2,000 fine on each of the two counts.[[0:15:30]] The board met in executive session (a closed-door discussion) to deliberate.[[0:15:55]] The board voted unanimously to fine the lounge $2,000 on count one and $2,000 on count two.[[0:17:12]] The chair said the lounge will be notified when payment is due.[[0:18:06]]
decided: The board voted by roll call to go into executive session to deliberate.
The board voted unanimously to fine the lounge $2,000 on count one and $2,000 on count two.
meeting.next: The lounge will be notified when payment of the fine is due.
